questions.text: Present Perfect formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: O'tmish + HOZIR bog'lanishi. Inkor: haven't/hasn't + V3.

questions.text: «I have seen him yesterday» — bu nega xato?
options: Aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: yesterday/last/ago → Past Simple: I saw him yesterday.

questions.text: «been» va «gone» qanday farqlanadi?
options: been — borib qaytgan; gone — hali u yerda
questions.explanation: He's been to Paris (qaytgan) ≠ He's gone to Paris (hali u yerda).

questions.text: «I've lost my keys» qaysi ma'noni bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Uch ma'no: hayotiy tajriba, hozirgi natija, tugamagan davr.

questions.text: «he's gone» dagi «'s» nima?
questions.explanation: V3 oldida 's = has; sifat oldida 's = is.

title: Test — Present Perfect: for va since

questions.text: «for» va «since» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: for 5 years ↔ since 2019.

questions.text: «5 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman» qanday aytiladi?
options: I am living here for 5 years
questions.explanation: O'zbekcha hozirgi zamon inglizchada Present Perfect bo'ladi.

questions.text: «How long...?» savoliga qanday javob beriladi?
questions.explanation: «When...?» savoli esa aniq vaqt va Past Simple talab qiladi.

questions.text: «3 years ago» qaysi zamon bilan ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: ago — aniq o'tgan vaqt belgisi, for/since dan farq qiladi.

questions.text: «since I started» — «started» nega Past Simple?
options: since + gap ichida Past Simple ishlatiladi
questions.explanation: I've known him since we started school.

questions.text: «yet» gapda qayerda turadi?
questions.explanation: Have you done it yet? / I haven't done it yet.

questions.text: «already» qaysi gap turida ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: I've already done it. already ↔ yet (ijobiy ↔ savol/inkor).

questions.text: «still» qayerda turadi?
questions.explanation: I still haven't finished — sabrsizlik ohangi bilan.

questions.text: «just» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: I've just finished — o'rtada, have va V3 orasida.

questions.text: «So far, so good» dagi «so far» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: recently/lately (yaqinda), so far (shu paytgacha) — hammasi PP bilan.

title: Test — Present Perfect va Past Simple

questions.text: Ikki zamonni ajratishning eng ishonchli qoidasi qaysi?
options: Aniq o'tgan vaqt bor → Past Simple; yo'q → Present Perfect
questions.explanation: Signal so'z eng ishonchli ko'rsatkich.

questions.text: «When...?» savoli qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?
questions.explanation: «When did you go?» — «When have you gone?» xato.

questions.text: Yangilik e'lon qilishda zamonlar qanday ketma-ketlikda keladi?
questions.explanation: He's hurt his leg. He fell down the stairs.

questions.text: «ever, never, just, already, yet» qaysi zamonning signali?
questions.explanation: Past Simple signallari: yesterday, last..., ...ago, in 2010, then.

questions.text: «this morning» qaysi zamon bilan ishlatiladi?
options: Davom etayotgan bo'lsa PP, tugagan bo'lsa Past
questions.explanation: Ertalab hali davom etsa PP; tush bo'lgan bo'lsa Past Simple.

questions.text: «This is the first time I ___ here» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: «This is the first time I've + V3» — hozirgi zamon emas, Present Perfect.

questions.text: «the best film I ___ seen» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Superlative + ever → Present Perfect: the best/worst ... I've ever + V3.

questions.text: «How long ago did you...?» savoliga qanday javob beriladi?
questions.explanation: «How long have you...?» esa for/since bilan javob oladi.

questions.text: «been in» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: been to (qaytgan) / gone to (hali u yerda) / been in (qancha vaqt).

questions.text: «the other day» qaysi zamon bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: recently/lately/so far/up to now → PP; the other day → Past.

questions.text: Present Perfect Continuous formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: «been» tushib qolmasligi kerak.

questions.text: «I've been reading» va «I've read 3 books» qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: How long have you been...? (vaqt) ↔ How much have you...? (natija).

questions.text: «I'm tired — I've been running» qaysi ma'no?
questions.explanation: Ikki asosiy ma'no: davomiylik (for/since) va hozirgi iz.

questions.text: «I've been knowing him» — bu nega xato?
options: know — stative fe'l, Continuous da ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: I've known him for years.

questions.text: «5 yildan beri shu yerda ishlayman» (jarayonga urg'u) qanday aytiladi?
options: I've been working here for 5 years
I am working here for 5 years
questions.explanation: for/since bilan davomiylikni ta'kidlash uchun PPC ishlatiladi.

questions.text: Past Perfect formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: O'tmishdan oldingi o'tmish. Inkor: hadn't + V3.

questions.text: «When I arrived, the train had left» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: «...the train left» esa: men kelganimdan keyin ketdi.

questions.text: «'d» qachon «had», qachon «would» bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: I'd finished (had) ↔ I'd go (would).

questions.text: Bitta o'tmish voqeasi haqida gapirganda qaysi zamon kerak?
options: Past Simple — Past Perfect shart emas
questions.explanation: Past Perfect faqat ikki voqea tartibini aniqlash uchun kerak.

questions.text: «by the time» qaysi zamon signali?
questions.explanation: Signal so'zlar: already/just/never (o'rtada), by the time, before, after.

questions.text: Past Perfect Continuous formulasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Hamma shaxsda «had been» — o'zgarmaydi.

questions.text: «When she came, I'd been waiting for an hour» nimani anglatadi?
options: U kelgunimcha bir soat kutgan edim
questions.explanation: O'tmishdagi nuqtagacha davom etgan harakat.

questions.text: «I was tired because I'd been working» qaysi ma'no?
questions.explanation: Ikki asosiy ma'no: nuqtagacha davomiylik va o'tmishdagi iz.

questions.text: «I'd been knowing him» — bu nega xato?
options: know — stative fe'l; to'g'risi: I'd known him
questions.explanation: Stative fe'llar (know/have/be) Continuous da ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: Uch davomiylik shaklining to'g'ri ketma-ketligi qaysi?
options: was working / have been working / had been working
questions.explanation: O'tmish davomiyligi → hozirgacha davomiylik → o'tmishdagi nuqtagacha davomiylik.
